absolute_layout.dark_note: MAUI dark: blue rect lower (~y520), green/red bars centered vertically (~y1040), "Centered text" at mid, selected blue-highlighted "AutoSized" label just below center; C++ dark: blue rect higher (~y310), green/red bars shifted lower (~y1185), "Centered text" missing/absent in C++ region while plain unhighlighted "AutoSized" sits far lower (~y1520) — elements are vertically mis-positioned and the "AutoSized" label lacks the blue selection background.
absolute_layout.light_note: MAUI light: gray rounded content card inset within safe area, blue rect + "Centered text" + green/red side bars + selected "AutoSized" label + a dark bottom button, all positioned inside the card; C++ light: white full-bleed background (no card), blue rect higher up, "Centered text" higher, NO "AutoSized" label, NO bottom dark button, plus a navigation bar ("MauiCompare" back) + Dynamic Island the MAUI shot lacks — different layout origin/insets, missing controls.

activity_indicator.dark_note: C++ dark is essentially blank — black screen with only the status bar and one small blue spinner centered — while MAUI dark renders all labels (Default/Styled.../Larger/Smaller), all spinners, and the yellow background band.
activity_indicator.light_note: Same labels/spinners/order, but C++ omits the yellow BackgroundColor band (no yellow rendered) that MAUI shows behind the third spinner, has a large black pill artifact at top-center, and adds extra trailing "Not Running"/"- End of page -" content; "Smaller" label wraps 1 line vs MAUI's 2.

adaptive_collection.dark_note: C++ dark is entirely blank/black (only status bar) while MAUI dark renders the full header + center-aligned Item 1-7 list.
adaptive_collection.light_note: MAUI center-aligns each item with large ~145px row spacing (only ~6.5 items visible); C++ left-aligns items with tight ~100px spacing (all 8 visible) and renders a stray black navbar pill at top — item alignment and row spacing differ.

alerts.dark_note: C++ dark is completely blank (status bar only, no labels or buttons) while MAUI dark shows the full page (white labels + blue interactive items).
alerts.light_note: C++ renders the six interactive items (Alert Simple/Yes-No, ActionSheet Simple/Cancel-Delete, Question 1/2) in plain BLACK text while MAUI renders them as blue (iOS tint) buttons; C++ also compresses vertical row spacing (content ends ~640px vs MAUI spread to ~975px).

alignment.dark_note: C++ shows only 4 empty red-outlined full-width rectangles with no blue fill, no button text, and section header labels (Start/Center/End/Fill) entirely missing; MAUI shows filled blue buttons with white centered text, per-row alignment, and white bold headers.
alignment.light_note: C++ buttons render as empty red-outlined full-width rectangles (no blue fill, no white text) ignoring Start/Center/End alignment; section headers are thin and mispositioned (right-aligned) vs MAUI's filled blue buttons with white centered text, correct H-alignment, and bold left-aligned headers.

animation.dark_note: C++ dark page is entirely blank/black (only status bar) while MAUI dark shows the rotated white label plus the two blue buttons and disabled grey "Cancel Animation".
animation.light_note: C++ label is flat/left-aligned (not rotated like MAUI's curved bot label), all three buttons render plain black enabled text vs MAUI's blue buttons with greyed-out disabled "Cancel Animation"; C++ also has a stray black blob in the title bar.

app_theme_binding.dark_note: C++ dark renders only the green and orange paragraph labels on a plain black screen — the "AppThemeBinding" heading, the "Using AppThemeBinding in a ResourceDictionary" label, the centered "Toggle theme (Light/Dark)" button, the "Theme: Light..." status label, and MAUI's white content surface are all missing.
app_theme_binding.light_note: Same controls/order/colors (green, orange, blue toggle, status); C++ wraps text wider (e.g. "Using AppThemeBinding in a ResourceDictionary" fits one line vs MAUI's two) and has slightly larger inter-row spacing — minor spacing/wrapping only.

application_control.dark_note: C++ dark is entirely blank (only status bar visible) while MAUI dark shows the full content: title, three blue action links, and footer status line.
application_control.light_note: C++ renders the three actions as plain black text (MAUI shows blue tappable buttons), "Quits the application" is non-bold (MAUI bold), tighter vertical spacing, and footer text differs ("Windows open: 0 | main window: none" vs MAUI's "Windows open: 1 | main window: (untitled) | main page: set").

auto_size_shapes.dark_note: Same as light: C++ drops the label text and draws an oversized near-circular ellipse clipped top/bottom, vs MAUI's contained wide horizontal oval; label missing and ellipse aspect/size wrong.
auto_size_shapes.light_note: C++ omits the "The Ellipse below..." label text entirely and renders the ellipse as an oversized near-circle that clips at top/bottom of the yellow band, instead of MAUI's contained wide horizontal oval; ellipse aspect ratio and sizing wrong.

basic_grouping.dark_note: C++ dark is fully blank/black (only status bar) while MAUI dark renders the complete grouped list with title, green headers, members, and orange footers.
basic_grouping.light_note: C++ omits the "This is a header" title, all green group-header labels (Avengers/Fantastic Four/Defenders), and all orange "Total members:" footers — rendering only flat member rows with ~3x larger row spacing; MAUI shows full grouped list (headers+footers, tight spacing).

basic_swipe.dark_note: Same layout breakage as light (oversized rows, labels below boxes, mispositioned footer label now clipped at left reading "a row..."); additionally C++ row labels render low-contrast grey-on-grey vs MAUI's clear white text.
basic_swipe.light_note: C++ rows are much taller (only ~3 fit vs 5 in MAUI), row labels sit below the grey box instead of vertically centered, and the "Swipe a row..." footer label is mispositioned (overlaps the middle row) instead of below the last row; stray black pill in status bar.

behaviors.dark_note: Same as light: C++ title is a small single-line label at top with Entry immediately below, while MAUI shows a large bold two-line heading and the Entry positioned much lower (~y=825). Title font size and vertical layout differ.
behaviors.light_note: C++ renders the title "Red when the number isn't valid" as a small single-line label at the top (~y=300) with the Entry directly under it; MAUI shows it as a large bold two-line heading with the Entry lower (~y=850). C++ also has a stray black pill in the nav bar.

border.dark_note: MAUI dark shows one centered red-bordered cream card with faint Bordered content text; C++ dark shows three stacked sections with two empty red-outlined rounded rects on black plus a yellow box, section header labels invisible on black. Completely different page.
border.light_note: MAUI light shows one centered red-bordered cream card with Bordered content text; C++ light shows three sections RoundRectangle, StrokeShape binded to Parent, Update StrokeShape with two empty red-stroked rounded rects, a yellow box, and Increase/Decrease CornerRadius button labels. Different content, layout, controls.

border_clip_playground.dark_note: Same layout defect as light: C++ red Border is full-width stretched vs MAUI's compact square, and inflated vertical spacing pushes nearly all content off-screen — only the RoundRectangle entry shows near the bottom, while MAUI dark shows the full stack (entry, Border label, Border Width slider, Corner Radius sliders).
border_clip_playground.light_note: C++ stretches the red Border to full width (~900px) instead of MAUI's compact ~190px square; layout spacing is hugely inflated so most controls (Border Width + Corner Radius sliders) are pushed off-screen, plus an extra black pill renders in the title bar and title text differs (MauiCompare vs maui_ios_gallery).

border_layout.dark_note: C++ shows only an empty white rounded Border outline — missing the colored segments and "Center" text, AND missing the entire "Stroke thickness: 5/40" label and Slider that MAUI renders above it (top of page is blank).
border_layout.light_note: C++ Border renders as an empty white rounded rect — missing the red/green/blue/green colored segments and the "Center" text MAUI shows inside it; C++ Slider is also wrong chrome (thick black line + black pill thumb vs MAUI's blue track + white circular thumb).

border_playground.dark_note: Same as light: MAUI shows cyan-gradient-filled rounded Border plus the form section below; C++ shows an empty black-interior dashed-yellow rectangle with no gradient fill and none of the form controls.
border_playground.light_note: MAUI: Border has cyan gradient fill, RoundRectangle shape with dashed yellow stroke, and a form (Border Content/Shape/Background entries + color picker) below; C++: Border is unfilled (white interior, square-ish corners) with a thinner dashed yellow stroke and NO form controls below it.

border_resize_content.dark_note: Same shape mismatch as light: MAUI dark shows red+blue circles, squares, triangles with blue "+" glyphs and Content Text/Entry/FontSize rows; C++ dark shows light-blue ellipses and wide rectangles (no red-fill column, no "+" content), different scroll offset cutting off the Entry, so controls, fill colors, and shape geometry all differ.
border_resize_content.light_note: C++ renders the shapes wrong: left-column shapes are circles/squares/triangle with red fill + blue "+" content in MAUI, but C++ draws stretched ellipses and wide rectangles, both columns light-blue (red fill column missing), and exposes extra Slider + "Image Scale" + Slider rows MAUI doesn't show — scroll/layout and shape aspect differ markedly.

border_stroke.dark_note: Same structural failure as light: C++ shows only red stroke outlines with empty (black) fills — orange Border content and "1/5/10" labels missing; slider/track absent, section title gone, and the two text labels overlap the top red box, versus MAUI's correctly filled orange bordered boxes, slider, and laid-out labels.
border_stroke.light_note: C++ fails to render the three StrokeThickness Border boxes and the height Border boxes: orange fills + "1/5/10" labels are missing, only red stroke outlines with white/empty fills remain; first section title gone, slider is a plain black bar with no track fill at wrong Y, and "Updating the Content Height"/"Content height: 60" text overlaps the red boxes.

box_view.dark_note: C++ dark omits the white section labels ("Default"/"Using Color"/"Background") that MAUI shows, and centers the boxes with extra top offset; boxes/colors match but text labels are missing.
box_view.light_note: Same 4 BoxView samples, same colors/order/labels; C++ stack sits a few px higher with slightly tighter vertical spacing and a touch more top inset — sub-control positional only.

button.dark_note: FIXED: tint text visible + colored fills render in dark too. Same remaining corner-rounding/spacing minor as light.
button.light_note: FIXED: unset text -> iOS tint; explicit BackgroundColor now fills (per-state backgroundImage). Remaining minor: MAUI default buttons have rounded corners + inter-button spacing; the explicit CornerRadius button should clip to a pill (masksToBounds); C++ bars are square + flush.

carousel_page.dark_note: C++ dark is entirely blank (only status bar) while MAUI dark shows the "Basic Horizontal Carousel" label and large centered "Item 1"; no carousel content renders at all in C++ dark.
carousel_page.light_note: C++ renders carousel as a static top-left wrapped text stack (Item 1/2/3 side by side) plus an extra "Position 0 — current: Item 1" status line; MAUI shows a single full-screen paged item card with large centered "Item 1" — carousel paging/item-sizing is broken.

chat_example.dark_note: C++ dark is entirely blank (only status bar) while MAUI dark shows the green "Hi there!" bubble (right) and blue "Hello — how can I help you today?" bubble (left).
chat_example.light_note: C++ drops both message bubbles: no green/blue rounded backgrounds, "Hi there!" not right-aligned, both lines are plain left-aligned black text starting at the left edge; also a stray black rounded navbar pill artifact at top-center absent in MAUI.

check_box.dark_note: Same checkboxes/colors/order, but C++ row spacing is greatly enlarged (rows ~2x apart) and the text labels (Default/Colored/Disabled/etc.) are not rendered beside the checkboxes; content overflows so "Is green? False" is clipped at the bottom edge, whereas MAUI fits everything compactly with bold labels.
check_box.light_note: Same controls/colors/order, but C++ row spacing is far larger (rows nearly double-spaced) pushing "Is green? False" off the bottom edge; C++ title labels are regular weight vs MAUI bold; C++ also shows a spurious black rounded nav-bar pill at top.

chrome.dark_note: C++ dark is blank (only the status bar) while MAUI dark shows the blue "Press or right-click me" label and white "Ready" text.
chrome.light_note: C++ renders the "Press or right-click me" label in black instead of MAUI's blue, draws a stray black rounded-pill artifact in the title-bar area, and shows a full-white page vs MAUI's white content card inset on a dark frame.

clip.dark_note: C++ dark is entirely blank (only the status bar) while MAUI dark shows the "Image" + "Clipped Image using RectangleGeometry" headers and their submarine images on black.
clip.light_note: C++ light renders the three text headers but ALL images are missing (blank white slots) — the submarine/clipped images that MAUI shows never appear; also a stray black rounded-rect artifact sits in the nav-bar area.

clip_corner_radius.dark_note: C++ shows only a gray image placeholder + 4 thumbless gray slider tracks; all text (title + corner labels) and the photo are missing, whereas MAUI dark renders white title/labels, the clipped photo, and sliders with white thumbs.
clip_corner_radius.light_note: C++ renders the clipped image as a blank gray square (no purple-robot photo) where MAUI shows the actual rounded-corner-clipped image; title text and sliders otherwise match.

clip_gallery.dark_note: C++ dark is entirely blank (only the status bar shows) while MAUI dark renders the "Image" and "Clipped Image using RectangleGeometry" labels plus their two gray image squares.
clip_gallery.light_note: C++ renders the section labels (Image / RectangleGeometry / RoundRectangleGeometry) but ALL gray image placeholders are missing (no images drawn), labels are spread far apart vertically instead of MAUI's compact image+label stacking, and there is a stray black rounded-pill artifact in the navigation/title bar; MAUI shows the two gray image squares directly under their labels.

clip_views.dark_note: Same defect as light: MAUI clips all 7 controls into the red skewed shape; C++ clips only the Editor row red and renders the rest as default-chrome (clear DatePicker/Entry/Editor, plain SearchBar, TimePicker), and date/time text differs (6/19/2026 & 12:00 AM vs 19.06.2026 & 0:00).
clip_views.light_note: C++ applies the red diagonal Clip to only ONE element (Editor/Grid row); MAUI applies it to all 7 controls (Button, DatePicker, Entry, Editor, Grid, SearchBar, TimePicker) all rendered as the red skewed shape. C++ shows plain default chrome instead, plus differing date/time text (6/19/2026 & 12:00 AM vs 19.06.2026 & 0:00).

clipping.dark_note: Identical set of failures to the light pair: full-bleed orange (no rounded container), collapsed "12345678" numbers, missing orange-red square (only a thin red bar), missing purple/light-blue bands, and only 2 black "Hey" labels instead of 4 cyan ones — layout/clipping/spacing all wrong.
clipping.light_note: C++ orange fills full screen (no rounded container/margins); numbers collapse to "12345678" with no spacing/blue color; the large orange-red overflow square is missing (replaced by a thin full-width red bar); only 2 black "Hey" labels shown vs 4 cyan ones on a purple band; purple/light-blue bands absent; button not blue-styled.

collectionview.dark_note: C++ shows only the "None" box and "This is the header" text — the entire 3-column CollectionView item grid is missing/blank, whereas MAUI renders the full grid (items 0-23).
collectionview.light_note: C++ adds extra chrome MAUI lacks: a "None" box + 3 "Selection/Previous (event/command): [none]" labels above the header; both then show the 3-col item grid, but C++ renders many more rows (0-41+ vs 0-23).

composition_gallery.dark_note: Same layout defect as light (colors themed correctly): C++ first canvas tall/narrow with shape group jammed top-right vs MAUI near-square centered; second canvas lines mis-positioned/unbounded with red line off-screen bottom-right.
composition_gallery.light_note: C++ first canvas is a tall narrow portrait rect (~580x1180) with the triangle/circle/bars group jammed top-right and overflowing; MAUI canvas is near-square full-width with the group centered. Second line-canvas also mis-sized: C++ lines unbounded, red line runs off-screen.

containers.dark_note: C++ border + frame boxes are empty (missing "Inside a border"/"Inside a frame" labels) AND the "Inside a content_view" text is absent entirely, whereas MAUI dark renders all three labels.
containers.light_note: C++ border + frame boxes render empty — missing their "Inside a border"/"Inside a frame" labels (MAUI shows both); "Inside a content_view" sits far lower; C++ nav bar has a black title-bar artifact blob.

content_view.dark_note: C++ dark is fully blank (only status bar) while MAUI dark shows "ContentView", two "Content" labels, and the blue "Swap content" button.
content_view.light_note: C++ light is missing the blue "Swap content" button entirely, places labels higher/top-aligned instead of vertically centered, and renders a stray black rounded pill in the title bar; MAUI shows all three labels centered plus the button.

context_flyout.dark_note: Same core controls match, but C++ overlays an extra Microsoft cookie-consent modal (Accept/Reject/More options) on a dimmed Bing page below the content, absent in MAUI; MAUI dark also shows the Increment button on a gray fill bar not present in C++.
context_flyout.light_note: Core controls (Increment btn, switch, labels, Entry, COOL ImageButton) match in order/text, but C++ renders an extra full Microsoft Bing web page (logo, search bar, creator chips, castle photo, copyright) below the COOL button that MAUI has not; MAUI also has a gray fill bar behind the Increment button that C++ lacks.

controls_stack.dark_note: C++ dark renders almost empty (content pushed up under notch): only a stepper, faint progress line, an OFF switch and a blue ring — missing title, button, entry, editor, searchbar, checkbox, green switch and slider that MAUI shows; control set and ordering wholly diverge.
controls_stack.light_note: C++ light shows a completely different/broken stack: missing the "Controls" title, "A Button", "An Entry", "An Editor" and "A SearchBar"; instead shows "Value: 25/100" label, black-tinted slider, stepper, black progress bar, OFF switch, blue activity ring + spinner — wrong control set, wrong order, wrong colors (black vs MAUI's blue/green tint).

custom_layout.dark_note: MAUI dark shows the same blue "Top/Left/Left/Right/Right/Bottom" labels on black; C++ dark is completely blank black with no content at all.
custom_layout.light_note: MAUI light shows the white content card with blue "Top/Left/Left/Right/Right/Bottom" labels positioned around the page; C++ light is blank (no card, no labels) with only a stray black rounded blob beside the title bar.

custom_size_swipe.dark_note: Same inversion: MAUI shows green content block (white+blue text) then status label below; C++ shows the "RightItems revealed" status label clipped at top of the green band with no SwipeView content text rendered below — order/positions transposed and content text missing.
custom_size_swipe.light_note: Layout order inverted: MAUI shows green SwipeView content block first then "RightItems revealed" label below; C++ puts "RightItems revealed" label at top (overlapping/clipping the green status band) and the SwipeView content text far lower, detached.

custom_swipe_item_view.dark_note: Same as light: C++ blue Frame renders as an empty rectangle (labels missing), positioned lower and taller than MAUI's filled card; C++ also omits the "Right items revealed (Favourite)" heading shown in MAUI.

cv_visual_states.dark_note: C++ dark renders correctly: both headers plus all item rows (Item 1-3, Item 1-4) in white. MAUI dark is broken — item areas render as solid white/black opaque blocks with no visible item text, so the two stacks diverge notably (C++ is the more complete one here).
cv_visual_states.light_note: MAUI light shows all CollectionView items (Single: Item 1-3; Multi: Item 1-4) as text; C++ light renders both section headers ("Single Selection"/"Multi Selection") but the item rows between/after them are blank/missing — C++ omits the CollectionView item content.

data_template_selector.dark_note: C++ dark renders only the SearchBar with the whole list area blank; MAUI dark shows the full populated day-of-week list below the SearchBar.
data_template_selector.light_note: Same SearchBar + same day-of-week list (same items/order/black-on-white); C++ rows have noticeably larger vertical spacing/line-height than MAUI's tighter rows.

date_picker.dark_note: Same as light: C++ shows bordered boxes + "6/19/2026" format + missing colored Background fills (MAUI shows the solid/gradient fills), and the C++ shot is rendered at a much larger zoom/scale so controls span nearly full width.
date_picker.light_note: C++ wraps every DatePicker in a visible rounded-rect bordered box (MAUI is borderless), uses M/d/yyyy "6/19/2026" vs MAUI's dd.MM.yyyy "19.06.2026", and renders NO background fills for the BackgroundColor/Background/gradient rows (MAUI shows solid-blue, yellow-green, and blue gradient fills).

device.dark_note: MAUI shows the three centered text lines (Platform/Idiom/Version); C++ dark is entirely blank apart from the status bar — content missing.
device.light_note: MAUI shows text H+V-centered inside a white rounded modal card; C++ has no card and the text is top-left aligned (not centered), plus a stray black pill artifact in the nav bar.

dispatcher.dark_note: C++ dark is blank — only the status bar renders, the entire text content area is empty black, while MAUI dark shows the full body text and blue links.
dispatcher.light_note: Body text + blue centered links ("Fail Access"/"Access"/"3 Seconds Later") match in content/position/color; differences are nav-bar chrome (C++ shows black rounded pill + "MauiCompare" back vs MAUI's translucent bar + "maui_ios_gallery") and slightly tighter line-wrapping in C++ that reveals more content below the fold.

drag_drop.dark_note: C++ pushes the swatch stack far lower (large empty top gap ~575px), swatches are thinner/differently proportioned, "Rainbow:" label overlaps onto the purple swatch instead of sitting in its own black-gap row, and only a red sliver shows at bottom — vertical positioning and swatch sizing differ markedly from MAUI's evenly spaced layout.
drag_drop.light_note: C++ swatches are much thinner/tighter-spaced and the "Rainbow:" label overlaps onto the purple swatch (vs MAUI's clean separated rows); C++ also renders a full drag-status text block (Self X:0 Y:0, Receiving layout X:10 Y:10, Move: swatch dropped...) that MAUI doesn't show, so overall vertical layout/sizing diverges.

editor.dark_note: FIXED: unset TextColor now resolves to UIColor.labelColor, so all rows render white on dark — LENGTH:0, FontSize (Large), "I am read only", "123", "This should be on the bottom", AUTOSIZE LENGTH:0 all legible, matching MAUI dark; placeholders gray, explicit purple preserved. Residual: vertical rhythm slightly looser than MAUI.
editor.light_note: Same controls/order/text/colors; rows sit a few px higher with text flush to the left edge vs MAUI's left inset (vertical rhythm).

effects.dark_note: MAUI dark also shows the iOS home screen, not the effects page; C++ dark renders the effects page (black bg, two Entry field outlines visible; labels/text black-on-black per dark theme).
effects.light_note: MAUI light shows the iOS home screen (springboard with app icons), not the effects page; C++ light renders the real page (two "Entry With Focus" labels + Entry fields "Alert Simple", Detach/Re-attach labels, "routing attached: yes").

ellipse_gallery.dark_note: C++ dark is missing all four text labels (only centered shapes shown, shifted lower) whereas MAUI dark shows white left-aligned labels with left-aligned shapes.
ellipse_gallery.light_note: Same 5 shapes/colors/order/labels, but C++ horizontally centers every shape while MAUI left-aligns them flush under the labels.

entry.dark_note: FIXED dark text: unset entry text now uses the dynamic system label color (white in dark, was black-on-black). Matches C# (white text, gray placeholders, purple explicit). Minor spacing only.
entry.light_note: Near-match: same fields, placeholders, explicit purple text, password dots, end-alignment. Minor: slightly tighter inter-field spacing + entry border rendering vs C#.

label.dark_note: FIXED dark text: unset labels now use the dynamic system label color (white in dark) instead of black-on-black. Residual: same missing gray BackgroundColor boxes as light.
label.light_note: Text + layout match; C# fills several alignment-demo labels with a gray BackgroundColor box that the C++ port doesn't render — label background-fill diff only.

modal.dark_note: C++ dark is blank (all-black screen, only status bar) while MAUI dark shows the full modal content: "Modal Page 1", the blue action links, and the depth status line.
modal.light_note: C++ renders the 5 action items as plain black text and fills the full screen white; MAUI shows them as blue tappable links (Pop Modal Page greyed/disabled) on a rounded white modal sheet over a black backdrop, with looser vertical spacing.

pan_gesture_events.dark_note: Same as light: label top-aligned in green (MAUI) vs centered (C++); green starts higher and red extends to the bottom edge in C++, while MAUI shows a black bottom band below the red.
pan_gesture_events.light_note: Status label is top-aligned within the green band in MAUI but vertically centered in C++; green band starts higher and the red band runs to the screen bottom in C++ whereas MAUI shows a white bottom band below the red.

picker.dark_note: Matches: all query text white (handler already left system default), blue title, gray placeholders; BackgroundColor=Yellow/Green now render as full flat fills matching MAUI dark (FIXED via UITextField backgroundColor property). Residual: vertical rhythm (C# taller rows).
picker.light_note: Matches: text colors (black query, blue TitleColor, gray placeholders) + BackgroundColor fills now render — Yellow/Green pickers show full flat fills (FIXED: iOS picker now pushes solid BackgroundColor to the UITextField backgroundColor property, suppressing the RoundedRect bezel like MAUI). Residual: C++ more compact vertical rhythm (fits more rows than MAUI) + top nav-bar blob (harness artifact).

preselected_items.dark_note: C++ dark is effectively blank — only "This is the header" on black, no description text or CollectionView items; MAUI dark shows the full 3-column grid with gray-highlighted preselected items.
preselected_items.light_note: C++ renders a 4-column grid with no selection highlight and a non-bold header; MAUI shows a 3-column grid with gray preselected-item backgrounds (photo.jpg 2 / Fruits.jpg 4 / FlowerBuds.jpg 5) and a bold header.

search_bar.dark_note: FIXED: unset TextColor now resolves to UIColor.labelColor, so query text renders white on dark, matching MAUI dark (green/pink explicit preserved, gray placeholders). Residual: search-bar row height differs (C# taller). (C# dark reference was a blank/black broken capture — re-captured.)
search_bar.light_note: Matches: same controls/order/text/colors (green/pink explicit, gray placeholders, black query text). Residual: C++ has a black rounded nav-bar blob at top (harness artifact), and C# search bars are taller (more vertical padding) so C# shows ~4 rows where C++ fits 7. (C# light reference was a blank/black broken capture — re-captured.)

shapes.dark_note: Same divergence as light: MAUI = Ellipse(red fill/blue stroke), RoundRectangle(solid navy), pentagram, Line; C++ = Ellipse(navy/RED stroke inverted), red-dashed Rectangle & RoundRectangle, thick Line, blue Polyline chevron, Polygon. C++ omits the pentagram, adds Rectangle/Polyline/Polygon, inverts ellipse fill/stroke, and uses dashed strokes vs MAUI's solid.

single_bound_selection.dark_note: C++ dark is fully blank (black screen, status bar only) while MAUI dark renders the full instruction text, "Selected: (none)", and all 5 country labels.
single_bound_selection.light_note: Same text content, but C++ uses much larger font/line-height: instruction wraps differently (ends "...this" vs "...not,") and the 5 country labels are widely spaced apart vs MAUI's tight single-line-spaced list; C++ also shows a stray black pill in the nav-bar area.

slider.dark_note: C++ dark is nearly blank — only a thin pink line and one orange pill near the bottom render; all labels and the other ~9 sliders are missing, whereas MAUI shows the full labeled slider list with native white thumbs and colored fills.
slider.light_note: C++ draws wrong slider chrome — a thick solid black full-width track with an oversized black pill thumb at left; MAUI shows native iOS thin tracks with a small white circular thumb and colored minimum-track fills (blue/gradient/etc.).

stack_layout.dark_note: MAUI dark shows ONLY white "Vertical"/"Horizontal" text on black; C++ additionally renders the full rainbow vertical color stack and bottom horizontal color strip — the colored stack content is missing on the MAUI side.
stack_layout.light_note: MAUI light shows ONLY "Vertical"/"Horizontal" text labels in a white card; C++ additionally renders the full rainbow VerticalStackLayout (red/yellow/blue/green/orange/purple bars), a bottom horizontal color strip, and an extra rounded black blob near the status bar — the colored stack content is missing on the MAUI side.

stepper.dark_note: C++ shows only seven bare dark stepper pills on black — all section labels ("Default", "Disabled", etc.), the blue "Enable Stepper" link, and the red BackgroundColor bar are missing, whereas MAUI dark shows white labels, the blue link, and the red bar.
stepper.light_note: C++ omits the red BackgroundColor bar behind that stepper, renders "Enable Stepper" as plain centered black text instead of MAUI's blue tappable link, and uses tighter vertical spacing/different scroll position; otherwise same labels and pill steppers.

swipe_item_size.dark_note: C++ content badly mis-laid-out: shows only a clipped "12x512 Icon" label plus bare gray boxes with NO "Swipe to Left" text and NO headers, huge empty black gaps — versus MAUI's correct compact list of labeled centered-text swipe rows.
swipe_item_size.light_note: C++ swipe rows mis-sized/detached from their labels (128x128 & 256x256 boxes collapsed/invisible, gray box overlaps "512x512 Icon" and clips "Swipe to Left" text); section headers not bold (MAUI bold); stray nav-bar pill artifact.

switch_grouping.dark_note: C++ dark is nearly empty — only a single OFF Switch floats mid-screen with no "Is Grouped:" label and no list content, whereas MAUI dark shows the full grouped member list with green headers and orange footers.
switch_grouping.light_note: C++ shows ungrouped flat list (no green section headers, no orange "Total members" footers), Switch is OFF and overlaps the "Thor" row, and rows have huge vertical spacing; MAUI shows a proper grouped list with ON switch.

templated_view.dark_note: Same as light: C++ shows only the two red labels while MAUI shows the standard CardView (Slavko Vlasic) plus the templated Compact cards with gray images and names; the ControlTemplate/CardView body is entirely missing in C++.
templated_view.light_note: C++ renders only the two red label blocks; all CardView content is missing — the standard card (Slavko Vlasic + body) and every Compact-card templated item (gray image + Carolina Pena/Wade Blanks/Colette Quint + descriptions) that MAUI shows are absent, leaving the page blank below the labels.

varied_size_selector.dark_note: C++ dark is entirely blank (black, only status bar) while MAUI dark renders the full colored variable-height cell list plus buttons, Index label, and entries.
varied_size_selector.light_note: C++ shows only 6 plain text labels (incl. extra Milk4/Coffee5) on white; MAUI shows variable-height colored cells (Coffee0/Milk1/Coffee2/Coffee3) plus Insert/Add/Remove buttons, an "Index" label, and two entries ("1", "Latte") — cell coloring, row sizing, and the entire button/entry control row are missing in C++.
